[IARC.7.12] **The undefined symbols of a shipped `libds.a` are a closed set.**
Each release row carries an allowlist of the symbols its `libds.a` may leave
undefined, and the build must fail on any other. A denylist cannot stand in for
it: a double helper missed by name (`__adddf3`, `__floatundidf`,
`__floatuntidf`, `__fixdfdi`) would resolve from the integrator's runtime and
put unadmitted arithmetic under [IARC.7.11]'s guarantee.
